_comment: Q9-AF v2 on CLEF-FLASH (jobs/q9af_v2 mode clefflash, a DIAGNOSTIC; jobs/q9af_v2/README_clefflash.md): configs/q9af_v2_clean_h100.json (job-7ji99's clean recipe) with exactly two changes, both in WHICH weights are converted, none in HOW: (1) model_dir = Cloudflare/clef-flash@17f0b0ad64efb65d273590632833508766b2aae6 (a merged LoRA on Qwen3.5-9B; same 32-layer layout, attention at 3,7,...,31), so the teacher of the KL distillation is Clef-flash itself in attention mode; (2) tokenizer_dir = the Qwen3.5-9B tokenizer at c202236235762e1c871ad0ccb60c8ee5ba337b9a (the tokenizer 7ji99 tokenizes with), so the mixture windows, held-out windows and probes are token-identical to 7ji99's (Clef-flash ships a newer tokenizer.json, same vocab, different pre-tokenizer: scripts/check_clefflash_v3w.py). Every other key is the clean config's, verbatim (tests/test_q9af_clefflash.py pins it). Original comment: Q9-AF v2 CLEAN RERUN (jobs/q9af_v2/JOB_SPEC.md 'Clean rerun'): configs/q9af_v2_h100.json (job-w3c2e) with exactly two changes. (1) mix.decontam full-eval-v1: dev13-v1 + the pinned eval-hash index (DEV + TEST + held-out, index_sha256 2c821e29..., shipped as hashes) + eval attack templates; job-vdk25 measured that this drops 1,066 of w3c2e's 249,744 train docs, and the 280M-token quota is refilled from later rows. (2) stage-2 wall clock 430 -> 385 min, to fit the $41 platform quote; stage 1, the init, the data, the floors and the gate are unchanged. Q9-AF v2 (jobs/q9af_v2/JOB_SPEC.md): ALL 8 attention layers of Qwen3.5-9B -> GDN at once (no per-layer gate, no rollback), init from the attention projections (reuse_attn; init_cmp is a 40-step diagnostic with a pre-registered switch rule), stage 1 layer-wise alignment of all 8 (wall-clock 70 min), stage 2 end-to-end KL with all 8 GDNs training jointly (wall-clock 430 min), on a generic DEV-decontaminated mixture (convert.mixdata: fineweb-edu / ultrachat in the Qwen chat format / finemath; 280M tokens, every window drawn once). Gate: jobs/q9af_v2/rule.py (held-out KL + stock Index proxy600). Stage rates / peak / floors as measured on job-5cmat / job-2xe5w (1xH100, micro_batch 4, 8 x 4096).
